subject: Dynamically add an arbitrary number of inputs

messages.author: 0fb11c33e887391c
messages.subject: Dynamically add an arbitrary number of inputs
parts:
The following app provides a minimal reproducible example and also gives a brief explanation of the problem:

https://gist.github.com/ncarchedi/2ef57039c238ef074ee7

To run it from the R console:

library(shiny)
runGist("2ef57039c238ef074ee7")

This Stack Overflow post gets at a similar issue, but is different because the user sets the number of inputs in advance:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/19130455/create-dynamic-number-of-input-elements-with-r-shiny

Any suggestions are much appreciated!

Nick
